values: ASPM Comparison: AccuKnox vs. Snyk vs. Veracode
✓ Yes - Confirmed capability  ✗ No - not available  △ Partial - in a limited form
Centralized findings across SAST, DAST, SCA, Container, IaC, Secret and API with SARIF ingestion and deduplication
Risk prioritization using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV and runtime-verified exploitability
Customer-configurable Rule Engine for automated status changes, ticket creation and notifications
Granular RBAC, SAML 2.0 SSO/OIDC (Azure AD, Okta, Auth0) and multi-tenancy
Audit trail logging actor, timestamp, component, action and result with raw-JSON drill-down
CI/CD integration with GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, CircleCI, AWS CodePipeline, Google Cloud Build, Harness
Custom rule creation without vendor professional services dependency
Secret scanning for hardcoded passwords, API keys, tokens and private keys in source and config files
Finding lifecycle with sticky statuses: Active, Waiting, Fixed, Duplicate, Accepted Risk, Exception Requested
Scan profiles: Baseline, Standard, Extended and Comprehensive with configurable crawl depth/duration
MFA/TOTP-aware authenticated DAST with live TOTP code generation and Logged In/Out/Fallback session states
Vulnerability coverage: SQLi, NoSQLi, CMDi, SSTI, XXE, SSRF, path traversal, CSRF, broken access control
Auto-progress findings Active → Waiting → Fixed on clean rescans with one-click Jira/ServiceNow ticketing
SBOM generation and export in SPDX 2.3 and CycloneDX
Dependency graph showing direct and transitive dependencies with path to each vulnerable component
Vulnerability intelligence enrichment from NVD, CISA KEV, MSRC, GitHub PoC, EPSS and CWE
License compliance classified as Permissive, Weak Copyleft, Strong Copyleft, Banned with CI/CD gating
SBOM version comparison to flag newly introduced or removed components across scans
Registry onboarding for Docker Hub, ECR, GCR, ACR, JFrog, Harbor, Quay and Nexus via dedicated dashboard
CRON-based scheduled scans per registry with scan-on-save and tag-pattern filtering
Registry scan dashboard with Vulnerabilities, Resources, Sensitive Data and Layers tabs
Air-gapped / isolated registry support for self-hosted JFrog and similar in segmented networks
API discovery analyzing live traffic to surface Shadow, Zombie and Orphan APIs
Spec ingestion: OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman Collections; REST, gRPC native, SOAP/GraphQL via DAST
OWASP API Top 10 mapping including BOLA, broken auth, excessive data exposure, misconfiguration
Continuous sensitive data detection (PII, PHI, financial) in API request/response payloads and headers
Gateway / service mesh integrations: AWS API GW, Istio, Kong, F5, NGINX, Azure API Management
Configurable rate-limiting at per-user/IP, global user/IP and global-service levels
Runtime enforcement via KubeArmor (CNCF) with eBPF/LSM for inline kernel-level mitigation
Workload protection across Kubernetes, VMs, containers, serverless and edge/IoT
Declarative Zero Trust policies that isolate workloads and block lateral movement inline
Runtime telemetry, container forensics and drift detection correlated with build-time findings
35+ prebuilt compliance frameworks: PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, NIST, STIG, MAS TRM, DPDP, SEBI CSCRF
GRC Evidence Packages with timestamped compliance evidence exportable in PDF, CSV and JSON
Enterprise dashboards spanning application, business-unit and organization level with SLA metrics
Full SaaS delivery with complete feature set
Self-hosted, AWS On-Prem/Hybrid and Managed OEM/MSSP models
Full on-premises / air-gapped deployment with customer-controlled vulnerability-DB updates
CLI-based: knoxctl (cross-platform incl. Windows) + Python ASPM Scanner CLI for pre-commit scans
Native CI/CD components for 9 platforms with configurable soft-fail/hard-fail gating
Full browser console to onboard registries, APIs, DAST targets and SBOM projects without CLI
xBOM suite: SBOM, HBOM, CBOM (PQC readiness), QBOM and AI-BOM across 12 BOM use cases incl. SLSA provenance
Single findings page for all scan types with consistent evidence layout
Built-in Ask AI to explain any finding's vulnerability, impact and remediation on the findings page
One-click Create Ticket to Jira/ServiceNow with severity-to-priority mapping and default assignee
Native Slack alerts plus generic Webhook for Teams, email, SIEM/SOAR
Ticketing: native Jira Cloud and ServiceNow with Rule Engine auto-ticketing
IDE: VS Code, Cursor, IntelliJ with SAST/SCA/secrets/IaC/ML/container, AI remediation, AI chat, pluggable scanners
